Chapter 308: Chapter 11: Perfect Seventh Stage, My Dao is Complete (Extra Chapter, Seeking Monthly Votes at the Beginning of the Month)

Door to the Myriad Realms.

Lin Yuan’s expression inevitably became solemn.

The Door to the Myriad Realms deep in his mind was not a physical entity.

It was but a strand of projection of the true Door to the Myriad Realms.

Bound to Lin Yuan’s true self and consciousness.

Thus, whether it was Lin Yuan himself or the Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit,

...

they all could “see” the Door to the Myriad Realms,

because they shared one consciousness.

Similarly,

when Lin Yuan traveled through worlds,

whenever his consciousness descended into other worlds, the projection of the Door to the Myriad Realms would appear in the mind of the vessel of Lin Yuan’s consciousness descent.

After breaking through to the Sixth Rank, Lin Yuan obtained much information from within the Door to the Myriad Realms,

including the fact that the physical body of the Door to the Myriad Realms was located in some mysterious place.

With Lin Yuan’s current strength, he simply couldn’t withstand the true Door to the Myriad Realms.

However—

Even if it was just an insignificant projection of the Door to the Myriad Realms,

it had a sense of being almost eternal and unchangeable, hard for external forces to affect.

Yet now,

the Door to the Myriad Realms deep within Lin Yuan’s mind was actually trembling slightly?

“What’s the reason?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts fluctuated.

“Because of this permanent spatial rift?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze once again turned to the nearby spatial rift, more than ten meters in size, from which a grey foggy gas was emanating.

The changes in the Door to the Myriad Realms started from the moment Lin Yuan saw this spatial rift.

As Lin Yuan pondered,

a surge of information flowed out from the Door to the Myriad Realms.

He quickly received it.

“Hm?”

“The speed at which the Door to the Myriad Realms accumulates ‘World-Breaking Origin Force’ has increased?”

Lin Yuan was startled.

Ever since he became aware of the Door to the Myriad Realms, the speed at which it accumulated ‘World-Breaking Origin Force’ had never changed.

Three hundred thirty-three days for one strand of World-Breaking Origin Force.

And it didn’t accelerate with the increase of Lin Yuan’s strength.

But now?

“The speed at which the Door to the Myriad Realms now accumulates World-Breaking Origin Force has increased to once every three hundred and ten days?”

Lin Yuan once again looked toward the spatial rift not far away.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan’s expression showed that he was deep in thought.

What was World-Breaking Origin Force?

Lin Yuan never fully understood before, only feeling that the energy needed by the Door to the Myriad Realms was something he had never heard of.

Now it seems, it’s related to the shattering of the world.

This shattering is fundamental, irreversible.

If it were just a spatial shatter, then during his fifth traversal, in the Immortal Tao World, Lin Yuan spent his last decades breaking through space, drifting among the chaos of the void. Logically, the speed at which the Door to the Myriad Realms accumulated ‘World-Breaking Origin Force’ should have increased.

But in reality, it did not.

“A great opportunity.”

“This is my great opportunity.”

Lin Yuan was overjoyed in his heart, after understanding the reason behind the Door to the Myriad Realms’ tremor, and realizing what kind of impact this would have on himself.

Is World-Breaking Origin Force important?

Most certainly, it’s the power source for the Door to the Myriad Realms.

In a sense, as long as there’s enough World-Breaking Origin Force, Lin Yuan can use the Door to the Myriad Realms to go to any world he wishes.

And he can bring back countless treasures from otherworldly realms without anyone being the wiser. Isn’t that an inconceivably powerful ability?

“If I get closer, will the speed at which ‘World-Breaking Origin Force’ accumulates increase?”

Lin Yuan converged his thoughts and pondered in secret.

From his current position, he wasn’t far from that spatial rift, but he wasn’t close either.

“All right.”

“In this kind of place, it’s best to be careful with everything.”

The armored man had roughly finished introducing things to Lin Yuan and turned to leave.

Lin Yuan stood there for a while, then cautiously moved closer to the spatial rift.

…

“A treasure trove.”

“This battlefield of different races is simply my treasure trove.”

On Chikun Main Star, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, feeling the Door to the Myriad Realms deep within his mind, with an increased speed of accumulating ‘World-Breaking Origin Force.’

His mood was extraordinarily happy.

Battlefields of different races were riddled with dangers, where human evolvers were at constant risk of falling.

The powerful Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin wasn’t he still defeated in such a small-sized otherworldly battlefield?

But as for Lin Yuan,

these battlefields of different races were simply treasure lands, places of blessing.

Ever since he sent his Primordial Spirit to the battlefields of different races, Lin Yuan had been reaping benefits constantly.

First was his understanding of space rules.

The spatial fluctuations in the battlefields of different races were obvious, making it relatively easier to comprehend space rules. Now, Lin Yuan was close to penetrating more than nine hundred of the basic spatial models.

Secondly, he acquired the legacy of an Eighth Layer Evolutionist.

Those treasures, even if they might not compare to Chikun Starlord, were definitely beyond those amassed by the old Seventh-Rank Peak Evolvers who had been accumulating for tens of thousands of years.

Especially that shattered soul defense droplet, which would stir the heart of ordinary Eighth Layer Evolvers.

“The spatial fluctuations are becoming ever clearer…”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his perspective shared. As the Taiyin Primordial Spirit approached the spatial rift, bursts of spiritual light constantly emerged.

[Your perception is heaven-defying, approaching the source of a shattered realm interface, your comprehension of the essence of space rules deepens…]

…

[Your perception is heaven-defying, approaching the source of a shattered realm interface, your comprehension of the essence of space rules deepens…]

…

[Your perception is heaven-defying, approaching the source of a shattered realm interface, your comprehension of the essence of space rules deepens…]

…

Rustle rustle.

Lin Yuan raised his hand.

Threads of spatial power coiled around it.

In an instant, the nine hundred fifty-first spatial model took shape.

“Marvelous.”

“Too marvelous.”

“So space can be manipulated like this?”

Lin Yuan lifted his hands, constantly playing with the spatial power, influencing the surrounding space.

At this moment, in Lin Yuan’s field of vision, space seemed like flowing water, and his every move could create ripples in this flow.

The ripples spread out, extending tens of thousands or even millions of miles away, constantly colliding and interweaving, eventually stirring up a spatial storm.

And this.
